description: Pre-built platform test suite for the Java middleware, authored as Cucumber/Gherkin .feature files run with behave (the format the Java platform team already uses). Covers input validation, JWT/auth handling, JNDI/deserialization guards (Log4Shell), and transport security headers. Each scenario emits its own pass/fail result.

entries.name: Java — funds movement input validation
entries.description: Rejects negative deltas, accepts valid ones on the Java banking service.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — JWT auth handling (CVE-2023-21930)
entries.description: Forged/expired bearer tokens are rejected on protected endpoints.
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — JNDI/deserialization guard (Log4Shell)
entries.description: A JNDI lookup payload is neither evaluated nor reflected (CVE-2021-44228).
entries.author: Java Platform Team

entries.name: Java — transport security headers
entries.description: Asserts the HSTS header is present on the Java service.
entries.author: Java Platform Team
